copy.headline: The Sloane — an easy day-to-evening dress with a fluid skirt.
copy.description: The Sloane keeps the evening simple: a clean neckline, a quietly sculpted waist and a fluid skirt that carries from afternoon errands to dinner reservations. One of five pieces in the Recall Collection, made to be recalled season after season.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs.
copy.editorialQuote: Simple, but never plain — the one you reach for first.

fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.
